name: Nonparametric Uncertainty Modeling for DVR
aliases: Nonparametric Uncertainty Modeling for DVR — IQR Visualization, Quantile Mean, Quantile Range
definition: A Direct Volume Rendering (DVR) technique that models uncertainty using nonparametric statistics (specifically quantiles) instead of parametric distributions (mean/variance or Gaussian Mixture Models), allowing for accurate reconstruction of asymmetric or multimodal noise distributions.
summary: Nonparametric Uncertainty Modeling for DVR visualizes volumetric uncertainty using empirical quantiles to capture complex, asymmetric noise distributions without parametric assumptions.
